scheme_name: Cattle Shed Subsidy Scheme under Scheduled Castes Sub Plan (SC Category)
other_conditions: Beneficiary must possess land in their own name or rented land (any duration, up to ten years or more)
Beneficiary must keep at least two animals
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹30,000 or 50% of the cattle‑shed cost, whichever is lower, for construction of a shed for two animals
